summary: Gjögur Airport (GJR/BIGJ) is a small regional airport serving the remote village of Gjögur on Iceland's Westfjords peninsula, one of the country's most isolated and least populated regions. The facility primarily supports the local fishing community and travelers exploring the dramatic, road-less landscapes of the northern Westfjords. With a single short runway and minimal infrastructure, the airport is well-suited to the light regional aircraft that link this corner of Iceland to the rest of the country.
